source.note: Response-only case: CompactInboundTransformer.TransformResponse turning a unified llm.Response (message with ReasoningSignature) back into the compact API client wire shape. Note this fixture (msg_001) intentionally differs from the outbound-response case fixture (msg_000) — they are two independent Go test literals. inbound_http, unified_request, selected_channel, outbound_http and upstream_http are null because the inbound response unit test does not exercise those stages. unified_response is an extension field recording the INPUT llm.Response fixture.

unified_response._comment: Verbatim transcription of the llm.Response literal the Go test feeds to TransformResponse (L127-148): RequestType compact, APIFormat openai/responses_compact, Compact{ID resp_001, CreatedAt 1764967971, Object response.compaction, Instructions 'Be concise', Output=[{ID msg_001, Role assistant, Content 'Hello', ReasoningSignature 'gAAAAAB...'}]}, Model gpt-4o, Usage{139,438,577}.

client_http._comment: Expected client HTTP response. Byte-asserted by the Go test: StatusCode==200, body unmarshals to CompactAPIResponse with ID 'resp_001', CreatedAt 1764967971, Object 'response.compaction', Model 'gpt-4o', Instructions 'Be concise', len(Output)==2, Output[0].Type=='reasoning' with *EncryptedContent=='gAAAAAB...', Output[1].Type=='message' with ID 'msg_001' and Content.Items==[{type:'output_text', text:'Hello'}], Usage input/output/total==139/438/577. Derived from compact_inbound.go (not separately byte-asserted): the reasoning item id is generateItemID() output (unstable, hence $ANY_ID); status:'completed' on both items (buildReasoningItem L1059-1083 in inbound.go, convertCompactMessageToItems L157-163); 'summary' omitted because ReasoningContent is nil (empty slice + omitempty); 'annotations':[] emitted on the text content item (non-nil empty slice with omitzero); usage detail zeros always emitted (responses.Usage has non-pointer detail structs without omitempty); headers from compact_inbound.go TransformResponse L109-116.
